name: animation
description: forces an animation onto a window, with an optional opt
help:
animation [style] ([opt]) forces a specific animation on a window.

- style: the animation style (e.g., slide, fade)
- opt (optional): additional parameters like direction or speed

Examples:

    animation slide
    animation fade 50

name: bordercolor
description: force the bordercolor of the window
help:
bordercolor [c] sets a custom border color or gradient.

- Single: color/color ... color angle → active border
- Double: color/color ... color angle color ... color [angle] → active & inactive

Colors must be defined in variables->colors.

Examples:

    bordercolor rgb(255,0,0) 0
    bordercolor rgb(255,0,0) 0 rgb(100,100,100) 0

name: idleinhibit
description: sets an idle inhibit rule to prevent idle behavior like screen dimming
help:
idleinhibit [mode] prevents idle actions based on the mode.

Modes:
- none: allow idle
- always: always inhibit idle
- focus: only when window is focused
- fullscreen: only in fullscreen

Examples:

    idleinhibit always
    idleinhibit fullscreen

name: opacity
description: sets window opacity (overall or by state)
help:
opacity [a] defines transparency for the window.

- 1 float: all states
- 2 floats: active and inactive
- 3 floats: active, inactive, fullscreen

Examples:

    opacity 0.9
    opacity 0.9 0.7
    opacity 0.9 0.7 1.0

name: tag
description: applies a tag to the window for rule matching or grouping
help:
tag [name] assigns or toggles a window tag.

- `+name`: adds tag
- `-name`: removes tag
- `name`: toggles tag

Examples:

    tag +music
    tag -music
    tag music

name: maxsize
help:
maxsize [x] [y] limits the floating window’s size in pixels.

Examples:

    maxsize 800 600

name: minsize
help:
minsize [x] [y] defines the smallest size a window can shrink to.

Examples:

    minsize 200 150
